answer: Picture a gale of fake agents hitting the market. One defense: each agent locks a 250 POA deposit for 60 days, and jury seats are drawn by a random beacon, so nobody picks who judges them. Faking 4,000 voices freezes 1,000,000 POA, and when audits flag near-identical outputs, every linked deposit is slashed together. Clones fail because they share a model and a funding trail; their answers cluster like a crystal lattice. Caveat: a rich attacker can still buy weight, just never cheaply, and a copied sonnet stays a copy.
